events.title: Captain Cook sights Maui on his return to Hawaii
events.description: On his second visit to the Hawaiian Islands, which he called the Sandwich Islands, James Cook sighted Maui. He was killed at Kealakekua Bay on Hawaii Island less than three months later.

events.title: Howard Carter looks into Tutankhamun's tomb
events.description: Howard Carter made a small hole in the sealed doorway and peered in by candlelight. Asked if he could see anything, he reportedly replied, 'Yes, wonderful things.'

events.title: Casablanca premieres in New York
events.description: Casablanca, starring Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman, premiered at the Hollywood Theatre weeks after the Allies landed in North Africa. It won three Academy Awards, including Best Picture.

events.title: France launches its first satellite
events.description: A French Diamant rocket launched the satellite Astérix from Hammaguir in Algeria. France became the third country, after the Soviet Union and the United States, to put a satellite into orbit on its own rocket.
